posts.text: Tennessee’s @GovBillLee announces a special legislative session starting Tuesday to draw a new congressional map. The goal will be to eliminate the Democrat seat in Memphis in the wake of this week’s Supreme Court ruling that ended racial gerrymandering.

10 of the 11 guards weren’t paying attention when the guy with the gun came running at them attempting to kill the president. And the one guy who was watching fired multiple shots from this close without hitting the would be assassin.

Imagine if this was an elite squad of trained assassins. All these dudes would have been wiped out in ten seconds. As is, this random teacher from California got past 11 guards — while running through the metal detector! — and only got stopped because he tripped and fell.
The president is alive today in spite of secret service protection, not because of it. That has to change. Present protection isn’t good enough. More attempts are coming. We have to stop them.

No. But don’t you think the guys protecting the president should be good at shooting at moving adversaries? Seems like kind of a key part of the job.


Everythings on the level..... (@TellsTimeWell)

You ever discharge a gun at a moving adversary?  It's hard



— https://nitter.net/TellsTimeWell/status/2050041218801840411#m

1. Every person with a job should have money in the stock market. We all start somewhere. I had a negative net worth at 32, two kids and was making $45k a year. 2. If you are able bodied and don’t have a job, that’s on you. Stop whining and start working.


Ole TDub (@twbryant88)

So if you have money, you’re making more money?  Excellent!  But what about literally everyone else?



— https://nitter.net/twbryant88/status/2049923375519220062#m

And if you have time to sit around and whine in the middle of a work day on social media from an anonymous account about the stock market hitting a record high, that’s wasted time, bud. You’d probably have money in the markets if you worked more and Tweeted less.

There is a legitimate argument that Ketanji Brown Jackson’s appointment to the Supreme Court — which President Joe Biden specifically said was directly intended to put a black woman on the Supreme Court — was unconstitutional under federal law.

Elite humor day from you commenters today. Well done, boys and girls. Keep up the good work.


Ayn Rand's Dog (@AynRandDog)

Next up, a remake of Brokeback Mountain, staring Livvy Dunne and Sydney Sweeney. Greatest box office $$ of all time.



— https://nitter.net/AynRandDog/status/2049952996965199950#m
